notes.title: About This Game
notes.notes:
[u][b]Question: Why is Infinity Wars called “Infinity Wars?”[/b][/u]

Answer: The name Infinity Wars is fictional terminology being personified as it’s own game genre. Such as how “Final Fantasy” continues with many sequels being created one after another. Infinity Wars strives to create it’s own sequels in a similar fashion that Final Fantasy does, so Infinity Wars is not actually endless warfare, but a specific event like Mortal Kombat where characters are summoned to defend the realm from imposing forces. Final fantasy is not final, they have characters return and continue their story line, Infinity Wars is not an eternal struggle/fight. So the term “Infinity Wars” is a video game genre.

[u][b]Question: Why choose this character as the main character?[/b][/u]

Answer: Originally the main characters was planned to be Sevarog from the game Paragon since their company is awesome and shared the same characters/animations that they use for their game, unfortunately the character Sevarog needed to be re-rigged which is not a difficult process. On the day 4/20/2019 I felt I had enough content in my UE4 library to start working on a new project, and since I didn’t feel like rigging a new character I decided to use another I already had purchased years ago. After a few days of work the skeleton reaper character had a lot of coding added to it’s animations so switching characters would be kind of annoying at this moment. At first the skeletons were going to be the bad guys, but I felt they complimented the reaper’s theme, so they joined forces… then I just made up a story about the reaper character.

[b]Fun Facts:[/b] The teleport spell in this game uses the same function that was used in our previous video game called "Time-Skip". So the teleport ability is already very accurate and reliable.

Infinity Wars had several different names during the development process, Trinity Wars sounded interesting but left the question, “Who’s the third faction?” Then another name “death wars” sounded too general, “Kingdom of Evo” was too specific. Eventually a name was to be decided and was inspired by Final Fantasy after several creative passes. Any similarities to someone else or their content, characters, or story is completely coincidental.
